text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hassan presides over opening session of Morocco's parliament, says he will use all his weight and constitutional powers to ensure that the 1997 legislative elections will be fair and transparent.
- Visiting French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon discusses with Moroccan officials on ways to develop cooperation.
- Farmers expect autumn rains on Sunday.
- Morocco reiterates its commitment to the U.N. referendum in the disputed Western Sahara.
- Mad or not, foreign caws will not be allowed in Morocco. Story refers to ban imposed by the authorities on beef and cow imports.
- Arab police officials to meet in Algiers on Monday to discuss terrorism issues in the Arab World.
